note: Receipts demo film. `text` is the caption (and the .srt line), `spoken` is what the voice says. {name} is filled from work/facts.json (see narrate.py); `at` = earliest start in seconds from the scene start.

lines.text: AI research assistants write fluent reports with confident citations.
But does the source really say that?
Courts have already ruled on {cases} cases where filings relied on hallucinated content.
lines.spoken: Courts have already ruled on {cases_words} cases where filings relied on hallucinated content.

lines.text: Receipts checks every cited sentence, against the source itself.
Paste a report.
Nemotron Nano, on Nebius Token Factory, pulls out each claim and the source it cites.
Tavily reads every cited page in full, and OpenAlex and arXiv track down the papers.
lines.spoken: Tavily reads every cited page in full, and Open Alex and archive track down the papers.

lines.text: Then Nemotron Ultra judges each claim against the passages that matter.
This briefing says data-centre demand grew {wrong_growth} a year.
lines.spoken: This briefing says data center demand grew {wrong_growth_words} a year.

lines.text: The IEA says {real_growth}.
It swaps China and Europe.
It credits the IEA with a forecast that is not in the IEA report.
lines.spoken: It credits the I.E.A. with a forecast that is not in the I.E.A. report.

lines.text: It cites a Nature Energy paper that has no record anywhere.
And one of its links is dead.
Every verdict carries a quote, matched word for word against the source.
It reads research papers too.
This related-work paragraph shrinks GPT-3 tenfold and inflates a BERT score.
lines.spoken: This related-work paragraph shrinks G.P.T. three tenfold, and inflates a Bert score.

lines.text: Receipts quotes the real numbers from the full papers.
And when a citation fails, Receipts goes looking for a real one.
Tavily searches the web with the claim itself, and Nemotron Nano checks each page.
This forecast was never the IEA's: it comes from McKinsey, by way of the World Economic Forum.
lines.spoken: This forecast was never the I.E.A.'s: it comes from McKinsey, by way of the World Economic Forum.

lines.text: On our benchmark, it found a real source for {suggest_k} of {suggest_n} misattributed or dead-link claims.
lines.spoken: On our benchmark, it found a real source for {suggest_k_words} of {suggest_n_words} misattributed or dead-link claims.

lines.text: Each Nemotron size has one job.
Nano extracts claims.
Super rewrites the few that lean on context.
Ultra judges, with reasoning on.
One Token Factory endpoint serves all three, so moving a job to another size is a single setting.
We measured every choice.
ReceiptsBench: {items} cited sentences from {sources} real sources, half with planted errors, written by an independent model.
lines.spoken: Receipts Bench. {items_words} cited sentences from {sources_words} real sources, half with planted errors, written by an independent model.

lines.text: Nemotron Ultra caught {ultra_k} of {ultra_n} problems with no false alarms, for about {ultra_cost} per claim.
lines.spoken: Nemotron Ultra caught {ultra_k_words} of {ultra_n_words} problems with no false alarms, for about {ultra_cost_words} per claim.

lines.text: Nano reaches {nano_macro} at a {nano_fraction_word} of the cost, one click away.
lines.spoken: Nano reaches {nano_macro_words} at a {nano_fraction_word} of the cost, one click away.

lines.text: Receipts. Check the citations before you trust the report.
